verses.translation: O you who covers himself [with a garment],[1788]
Arise and warn

segments.gloss: to stand up, to rise, to establish

verses.translation: And your Lord glorify
And your clothing purify
And uncleanliness[1789] avoid
verses.footnotes: [1789]- Specifically, idols or generally, bad conduct and morals.

verses.translation: And do not confer favor to acquire more[1790]
verses.footnotes: [1790]- An alternative meaning is "Do not consider any favor you have conferred to be great."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, jussive, 2nd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 2nd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: But for your Lord be patient.
And when the trumpet is blown,

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.translation: That Day will be a difficult day
For the disbelievers - not easy.
Leave Me with the one I created alone[1791]
verses.footnotes: [1791]- i.e., without wealth or children. The reference is to al-Waleed bin al-Mugheerah, who after inclining toward the Qur’ān, denied it publicly in order to win the approval of the Quraysh.

verses.translation: And to whom I granted extensive wealth
And children present [with him]

segments.description: Active participle — accusative, masculine, plural, indefinite

verses.translation: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].
Then he desires that I should add more.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.
I will cover him with arduous torment.

segments.gloss: to be hard on, to overburden, to cover

verses.translation: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.[1792]
verses.footnotes: [1792]- About what he would say concerning the Qur’ān and how he might discredit the Prophet (ﷺ).

verses.translation: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.translation: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.translation: Then he considered [again];
Then he frowned and scowled;
Then he turned back and was arrogant

verses.arabic: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ
verses.translation: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.translation: This is not but the word of a human being."
I will drive him into Saqar.[1793]
verses.footnotes: [1793]- One of the proper names of Hell.

verses.translation: And what can make you know what is Saqar?
It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.translation: Altering [i.e., blackening] the skins.
Over it are nineteen [angels].

verses.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةً وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًا وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًا كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
verses.translation: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allāh intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allāh send astray whom He wills and guide whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And it [i.e., mention of the Fire] is not but a reminder to humanity.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular
segments.gloss: to be convinced, to be certain

verses.translation: No! By the moon
And [by] the night when it departs
And [by] the morning when it brightens,
Indeed, it [i.e., the Fire] is of the greatest [afflictions]
As a warning to humanity -

verses.arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
verses.translation: To whoever wills among you to proceed[1794] or stay behind.
verses.footnotes: [1794]- To righteousness by acceptance of the warning.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular
Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.translation: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained[1795]
Except the companions of the right,[1796].
verses.footnotes: [1796]- i.e., the righteous who receive their records in their right hands.

verses.translation: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural
segments.gloss: to question, to ask, to inquire

verses.translation: About the criminals,
[And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"
They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,
Nor did we used to feed the poor.
And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],

segments.gloss: to engage in idle talk, to converse vainly

verses.translation: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
Until there came to us the certainty [i.e., death]."
So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.translation: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away
As if they were alarmed donkeys
Fleeing from a lion?

verses.arabic: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً
verses.translation: Rather, every person among them desires that he[1797] would be given scriptures spread about.[1798]
verses.footnotes:
[1797]- Instead of Muḥammad (ﷺ).
[1798]- i.e., made public. Much of their refusal of his message was due to envy and jealousy of the Prophet (ﷺ).

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular
segments.gloss: to intend, to desire, to want, to wish

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.translation: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.translation: No! Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder
Then whoever wills will remember it.

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
verses.translation: And they will not remember except that Allāh wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
